cultivate_v2_desc: Cultivates ground and levels ground based on player position. Use shift + click to level ground based on where you are pointing (this will smooth the terrain).
mud_road_v2_desc: Levels ground based on player position. Use shift + click to level ground based on where you are pointing (this will smooth the terrain).
path_v2_desc: Creates a dirt path without affecting ground height.
paved_road_v2_desc: Creates a paved path and levels ground based on player position. Use shift + click to level ground based on where you are pointing (this will smooth the terrain).
raise_v2_desc: Raise grounds up to a maximum of 8 m above it's original height.
replant_v2_desc: Replants terrain without affecting ground height.
cultivate_v2_square_desc: Cultivates ground according to the world grid and levels terrain based on player position. Use shift+click to level ground based on where you are pointing (this will smooth the terrain).
cultivate_v2_path_desc: Cultivates ground without affecting ground height.
cultivate_v2_path_square_desc: Cultivates ground according to the world grid without affecting ground height.
replant_v2_square_desc: Replants terrain according to world grid without affecting ground height.
mud_road_v2_sq_desc: Levels ground according to the world grid based on player position. Use shift+click to level ground based on where you are pointing instead (this will smooth the terrain).
raise_v2_precise_desc: Raise ground with precision accuracy by using scroll wheel to set ground height.
lower_v2_desc: Lowers ground just like digging with a pickaxe but will never generate stone from digging.
path_v2_square_desc: Creates a dirt path according to the world grid without affecting ground height.
paved_road_v2_square_desc: Creates a paved path according to the world grid and levels ground based on player position. Use shift+click to level ground based on where you are pointing (this will smooth the terrain).
paved_road_v2_path_desc: Creates a paved path without affecting ground height
paved_road_v2_path_square_desc: Created a paved path according to the world grid without affecting ground height
shovel_item_desc: Like a pickaxe, but much better at digging and much worse at mining
